name: For Whom the Stars Shine
source:
"Some stories are best told to none," she whispered.

Long ago, the stars disappeared. Then, a man returned them. Few would believe such a thing; fewer still can recall his name or how he bent the heavens' ears. It's a story of romance and tragedy that the stars themselves testify of to this day.

However, you won't find the tale in books or archives—only in the hearts of those who were there.

[From [url=https://newdialog.itch.io/fwtss]itch.io[/url]]
